name: Felsőszentmárton (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőszentmárton (a white shield with Saint Martin on horseback, a checky field and water) between scrolls inscribed MARTINCE above and FELSŐSZENTMÁRTON below.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
